episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Having decided to leave Hinoshima, Tonbo boards a ferry with Igarashi, bound for Kagoshima. On the ship, the two reflect on their time living on the island. As she starts to look toward the future, the warm presence of the island's residents, who have been watching over her, stays by her side.
